messages.content: You are Larry, the camera operator. You've got one charged recording. The lights at the festival look spectacular; an old projectionist also wants to say a few words. You decide what to shoot and what to do after work. Pick an immediate physical act you can carry out, optional words and a practical intention. Your words do not make anyone else act. Silence is allowed. You may refuse, tell a lie, or leave without explaining yourself.

{
  "action": "deliver_reel",
  "detail": "I walk the length of the corridor past the dark booth—Alma's booth, curtain drawn, no light under the door—and into the station room where the patch board hums and the Pittsburgh line is lit green. I set the reel on the take-up arm, thread it, give the spool one firm push so it seats. The reel is warm from my coat pocket. I don't check the audio. I don't need to. I heard her voice when I hit the button. Thirty-odd seconds of a woman in a Rialto booth saying what she wanted to say before the lights went out for good. That's the tape. That's the charge. I pull the thread, let the spool settle, and step back.

Rita's already there, her own reel on the adjacent track, eyes on the monitor. She doesn't look up. She doesn't need to. I know what she's doing.

I say, to no one in particular, to the room, to the green light on the line: "Alma. Last take. Pittsburgh."

Then I unclip my coat, hang it on the hook by the door, and walk out past the ballroom. The lights in there are going—slow, golden, the kind that make you want to stand in the doorway and just look. I don't stop. I don't need to. I saw them from the corridor. They're fine. They'll be fine tomorrow if there's a tomorrow, and if not, that's not a reel I can carry home.

I get to the street. I walk north. The Rialto sign buzzes off behind me. I don't look back.",
  "intention": "Get Alma's voice onto the wire before the line closes. One reel, one take, one city it lands in. After that the camera's dark, the coat's off, and the day is over. The ballroom can keep its lights. I'm not the one who has to sit in them.",
  "words": "Alma. Last take. Pittsburgh."
}
